extraction_focus: Pay close attention to specific tools, libraries, services, and their versions. Extract named engineers and their ownership or responsibility. Capture technical decisions with their rationale, including trade-offs mentioned.
compaction_preserve: Named engineers and their roles, specific tool versions and decisions, bug reports with symptoms, deployment dates and outcomes, architectural decisions with reasoning.
compaction_compress: General coding explanations, repeated stack descriptions, boilerplate problem context already captured in earlier summaries.
